content.title: Watch NCAA® March Madness® basketball games live on Hulu
content.text: Jan 20, 2026 From the first shot to the final dunk, Hulu + Live TV has your entire 2026 NCAA® March Madness® live TV experience covered. Select one of the options below to learn more about watching NCAA® March Madness® on Hulu: When is NCAA® March Madness®? What do I need to watch NCAA® March Madness® on Hulu? How do I find NCAA® March Madness® games on Hulu?How do I get the most out of NCAA® March Madness® on Hulu? When is NCAA® March Madness®? Men’s TournamentThe 2026 Division I men’s college basketball tournament starts with Selection Sunday® on March 15, followed by the First Four on Tuesday, March 17. It comes to an end with the Final Four® on Saturday, April 4 and the Championship on Monday, April 6. Live game coverage will air on available CBS affiliates and nationally on TNT, TBS, and TruTV. For the full schedule, please visit NCAA®’s site. Women’s TournamentThe 2026 Division I women’s tournament starts with the selection show on Sunday, March 15, followed by the First Four on Wednesday, March 18. The tournament comes to an end with the Final Four® on Friday, April 3 and the Championship on Sunday, April 5. Live coverage of the women’s games will air on available ABC affiliates and nationally on ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, and ESPNews. For the full schedule, please visit NCAA®’s site.Please note that game day schedules are subject to change. BACK TO TOP What do I need to watch NCAA® March Madness® on Hulu? To access live games and see what matches are coming up next, go to the Men's and Women’s College Basketball Sports hub collections, or open the NCAA® March Madness® hub in-app and on Hulu.com. If you’re in the middle of live streaming, use the Guide to look ahead (or switch between) the games airing on CBS, TBS, TruTV, and TNT for mens game, and ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, and ESPNews for womens games. BACK TO TOP Get the most out of NCAA® March Madness® live on Hulu Don't let the madness compromise your game day coverage. Catch every play on Hulu with these features and pro-tips: Follow your teamsOnce the tournament starts, log in to any of your Live TV supported devices to pick and add your favorite NCAA® men’s and women’s basketball teams to My Stuff. Hulu will follow your selections throughout the season, recording games, and surfacing them to the top of your Home screen collections for easy access. Keep up with game timesEnable push notifications on your mobile devices to keep up with game start times. Watch multiple games at once on Hulu.comSubscribe to the Unlimited Screens Add-on and fill your screen with multiple browser windows to watch several games at once. Multitask while you streamUse Picture-in-Picture on Hulu.com to minimize your current stream to a small, moveable window — freeing up the rest of the site for browsing games and checking start times. More ways to watchDownload the NCAA® March Madness® Live app or head to the website and use your Hulu + Live TV login credentials to sign-in. You’ll be tuning-in courtside in no-time. BACK TO TOP
